name: Fornax
introduction: is the Furnace, a faint constellation introduced by Nicolas-Louis de Lacaille in the 1750s, originally the chemical furnace of a laboratory. It lies in the southern sky within the bend of Eridanus.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Fornax is a window into the distant universe. In 2004, the Hubble Space Telescope stared at a seemingly empty patch here for more than eleven days, creating the Hubble Ultra Deep Field. It revealed about 10,000 galaxies, some seen as they were less than a billion years after the Big Bang.
The Fornax Dwarf, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way, even has six globular clusters of its own.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Dalim](hip:14879), Alpha Fornacis, is a binary star 46 light-years away. [Beta Fornacis](hip:13147) is a yellow giant.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: The Fornax Cluster, about 60 million light-years away, is one of the nearest galaxy clusters. It includes the barred spiral NGC 1365 and Fornax A, a giant galaxy whose radio jets extend far beyond its visible light.
